# std.bits

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Bit sets: sets of small non-negative integers, 63 per word. `contains`
is O(1); `insert` and `remove` copy the words (O(n / 63)); `union`,
`intersection`, and `difference` work word by word. Every operation
returns a new set.

    let s = bits.of([1, 5, 64])
    s.contains(5)          // true
    s.union(bits.of([2])).to_list()   // [1, 2, 5, 64]
